comparisons.peer_summary: Intel's 2024 revenue was $53.1 billion, a 2% decrease from 2023, driven by significant declines in All Other and Intel Foundry external revenues, which were partially offset by a 3% increase in Intel Products revenue.
comparisons.comparison: Both QCOM and INTC disclose fiscal year 2024 revenue performance broken down by specific business segments or categories, noting how higher demand in one area offset declines in another. QCOM reports QCT revenue increased 9% driven by higher handsets and automotive, partially offset by lower IoT revenues. Similarly, INTC reports overall revenue decreased 2%, driven by declines in All Other and Foundry revenues, which were partially offset by a 3% increase in Intel Products revenue (driven by CCG and DCAI). Both companies highlight a mix of growth and decline across distinct operational buckets to explain the top-line result.

sentences.text: • QCT revenues increased by 9% in fiscal 2024 compared to the prior year, primarily due to higher handsets and automotive revenues, partially offset by lower IoT revenues.
2024 revenue was $53.1 billion, down $1.1 billion, or 2%, from 2023 due to lower all other revenue and lower Intel Foundry revenue, partially offset by higher Intel Products revenue.
Intel Products revenue increased 3% from 2023 due primarily to higher CCG and DCAI revenue.
